results.title: The point count of $y^2=x^3-x$ as a quartic Jacobi sum
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For multiplicative characters $\chi,\varphi$ of $\mathbb F_p$ with values in $\mathbb Z[i]$ (as in quartic characters), the *Jacobi sum* is $J(\chi,\varphi)=\sum_{t\in\mathbb F_p}\chi(t)\varphi(1-t)$. For a prime $p$, $\left(\frac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ is the quadratic character of $\mathbb F_p$.
